Definition: Whether payment system operators or regulators regularly publish performance metrics and statistics on system usage, transaction volumes/values, participant numbers, uptime, and other operational indicators.
Comments: The Bank of Ghana publishes an annual Payment Systems Oversight Annual Report covering all payment system activity. The most recent available is the 2023 report (published September 2024), which provides detailed statistics on GIS, GACH, CCC, e-zwich, gh-link, GhIPSS Instant Pay, internet/mobile banking, ATMs, POS, and mobile money including transaction volumes, values, and growth rates. The Payment Systems and Services Act 2019 (Section 41-42) requires PSPs to submit periodic returns to the Bank of Ghana. There is no evidence of monthly or quarterly public reporting; the standard cadence is annual public reports, though internal supervision is more frequent.
